title: MV PKM Plugin ReferenceError: "notVeryEffective is not defined"

posts.author: dwr7eleven
posts.body:
So guys, last night, I was using the
SRD Pokemon Type System
plugin for RPG Maker MV, and I was setting everything up. I gave my party members, an enemy, and the attacks a Pokemon Type. But as soon as I got into a battle... I got into a fight with my enemy, and then this happened:
Which never made sense to me. No matter what attack I hit the enemy with, no matter what attack the enemy used against me, no matter who the enemy is targeting, I always get the same error.
Because the video on the current SRD Website is private (for whatever reason), I had to use the WayBack Machine to follow the tutorial.
Archived SRD Plugin
I followed that tutorial to a T. I put the plugin in the right location, I put the (copypaste elements) in the exact order and place that SRD wanted me to via Notepad, and once I have the plugin installed, these are the elements and the parameters that I set up.
Elements:
Parameters:
If you would like a simpler translation on how these elements and parameters work exclusively to my game, I have provided a visual here:
After setting up my parameters, I have assigned a type to my party members, an enemy, and the moves.
Party:
Enemy:
Moves:
After getting everything set up, I always end up with the same error. The SRD PKM Plugin is the only one that I'm using. The error goes away once I turn the plugin off. I followed all of the instructions. How do I fix this error regarding the plugin that I am using?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
When you get an error message, you need to press F8, go to the Console tab, and provide a screenshot of the full error trace.
We can't help just from the generic error message.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There's a typo on the indicated line. Open the plugin in a text editor, go to line 780, and where it says
notVeryEffective
put
SRD.PKM.TypeSystem.
in front.
Looks like there's the same mistake on the next line, and on lines 786 and 787 before noEffect.
